subject: SecurityPkg/Tcg2Config: use ArmFfaGetPartitionInfo() in Tcg2ConfigFfaPeim
reasons: Part of the ArmFfaGetPartitionInfo() migration series (c16f1cc684 introduces the helper; 96ad9bd397, 8955d8db32, b80000847a convert call sites).

Each call site removes the same manual FF-A descriptor lookup boilerplate: ArmFfaLibPartitionIdGet + ArmFfaLibGetRxTxBuffers + ArmFfaLibPartitionInfoGet(..., FFA_PART_INFO_FLAG_TYPE_DESC, ...) + Rx-buffer parse/release, replaced by a single ArmFfaLibGetPartitionInfo (Guid, &Info) call.

Taken individually each commit changes one function, but across the series the same before/after shape repeats in Tcg2ConfigFfaPeim, MmCommunicationDxe/Pei, and Tpm2ServiceFfaLib, which is enough repetition for a robust rule.
Implemented as 96ad9bd397-armffa-get-partition-info.cocci (plus a simplified variant); test fixtures cover all three call-site commits.
candidate_pattern: Replace manual FF-A descriptor partition-info lookup boilerplate (ArmFfaLibPartitionIdGet, ArmFfaLibGetRxTxBuffers, ArmFfaLibPartitionInfoGet with FFA_PART_INFO_FLAG_TYPE_DESC, Rx-buffer descriptor copy and release) with a single ArmFfaLibGetPartitionInfo (Guid, &Info) call
